title: Encoding & text
lede: Web-standard TextEncoder/TextDecoder for converting between strings and bytes, as Node's own lib/internal/encoding.js. TextEncoder is UTF-8 by definition; TextDecoder decodes UTF-8, UTF-16LE/BE and every single-byte encoding of the WHATWG list (the ISO-8859 and windows code pages, KOI8, IBM866, macintosh), with fatal, ignoreBOM and streaming. The CJK encodings, which Node decodes through ICU, are not supported. (atob/btoa and encodeURI(Component) live under global functions, not here.)

entries.name: TextEncoder
entries.signature: new TextEncoder().encode(str: string): Uint8Array; encodeInto(src, dest): { read, written }; encoding: string
entries.description: Encodes a string to its UTF-8 bytes as a Uint8Array. encodeInto(src, dest) writes whole code points into a caller-supplied Uint8Array and returns { read, written } (read counts UTF-16 code units), and .encoding is "utf-8".

entries.name: TextDecoder
entries.signature: new TextDecoder(label?: string).decode(bytes: Uint8Array | ArrayBuffer): string
entries.description: Decodes any ArrayBuffer, SharedArrayBuffer or ArrayBufferView as UTF-8, UTF-16LE/BE or any single-byte WHATWG encoding (windows-1252 for the latin1/ascii labels, ISO-8859-7/windows-1253 Greek, KOI8-R, …). Invalid or unmapped bytes become U+FFFD, or throw ERR_ENCODING_INVALID_ENCODED_DATA with fatal; a leading byte order mark is dropped unless ignoreBOM; decode(chunk, { stream: true }) keeps an incomplete sequence for the next call.
differences: The CJK encodings (GBK, GB18030, Big5, EUC-JP, EUC-KR, ISO-2022-JP, Shift_JIS), which Node decodes through ICU, throw ERR_ENCODING_NOT_SUPPORTED.
